status: Descriptive aggregate fit; no independent predictive validation

external_challenge.interpretation: The smooth model misses early-flight adaptation. Cohort/protocol differences also prevent an individual-accuracy claim.

checks.study: Smith SM, Heer MA, Shackelford LC, Sibonga JD, Ploutz-Snyder L, Zwart SR. J Bone Miner Res 2012;27(9):1896-1906
LeBlanc A, et al. Osteoporos Int 2013;24(7):2105-2114

countermeasure_direction.interpretation: The plans rank in the same direction as NASA crews. Effect sizes are assumed, not fitted.
countermeasure_direction.not_established: How many minutes of exercise produce how much benefit, and the size of the medication effect. Next step: obtain the full text (Smith 2012 Table 3; LeBlanc 2013 Table 2) and fit countermeasure_max_effect.

limits: Group means are not individual records; their ratio is not the mean paired percentage change.
SE describes the mean, not an individual prediction interval. Paired covariance is unavailable.
Postflight days 7–14 are represented by day 11 for the fit; this is a chosen approximation.
Recovery and exercise equations are assumed. Back-calculating landing values does not measure landing outcomes.
No randomized no-exercise arm; minutes-to-benefit and no-exercise scenarios are illustrative.
Daily interpolation, long missions and Moon/Mars conditions are not established by this cohort.
Sprint and the 2023 multisystem study may overlap; they are not independent validation sets.
